subject: Evidence request: new-joiner verification, training completion, and offboarding logs
messages:
From: SecureAudit <evidence@secureaudit.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: CAIQ / SIG - employee vetting and training artifacts

Hi Hannah,

As part of our SOC 2 scoping and SIG review for Redwood Inference, we need to validate employee identity verification and training controls covering calendar year 2024. Specifically requesting:

- A summary of background checks performed for hires (name, hire date, check type, result) for new-joiners onboarded in 2024.
- Evidence of mandatory security awareness training completion for all employees (training module, completion date, any exceptions).
- Offboarding logs showing account deprovisioning / access revocations for terminated employees in 2024.

If possible please provide CSV/CSV exports and the LMS report (PDF). Deadline for initial evidence: Friday 2025-04-25 COB. If there are any known gaps (historical manual processes etc.) call them out so we can document compensating controls.

Thanks,
Tanya Roberts
Senior Assurance Analyst
SecureAudit Inc.
[evidence@secureaudit.com]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: CAIQ / SIG - employee vetting and training artifacts

Neha — forwarding SecureAudit's request (below). Can you pull the HR exports and background check summary for all hires in 2024? We need the following by Thursday EOD so we can review before sending:

- background_checks_summary.csv (name | hire_date | check_type | outcome | vendor_ref)
- termination-log-2024.csv (user | termination_date | systems_revoked | ticket_ref)
- onboarding_checklist.xlsx (signed by manager where available)

Marcus — can you export the LMS completion report for 2024 and highlight any outstanding or remediation cases?

This is for SecureAudit; they requested by Friday COB. If you anticipate data redaction needs (PII) flag me and we will route to legal.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance Operations
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: CAIQ / SIG - employee vetting and training artifacts

Hi Hannah / team,

Quick update — attached is the initial background_checks_summary.csv export for 2024 hires (columns: name, hire_date, check_type, outcome, vendor_ref). Notes:
- We use VerifyRight for criminal + ID verification since 2021.
- Pre-2022 hires have partial records in legacy HRIS; we flagged those rows in the CSV with "legacy_check_needed".
- For third-party contractors (short-term), we redacted vendor identities per contract, but included outcome (pass/fail).

I will compile termination-log-2024.csv next; this requires cross-checking offboarding tickets in the access-management queue (TEX-432 / ITSM). I expect to have a draft by EOD Thu.

Attachments: background_checks_summary.csv, onboarding_checklist.xlsx (manager sign-off fields included where present).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: CAIQ / SIG - employee vetting and training artifacts

Adding LMS export and context for training items. Attached: training_completion_report.pdf (LMS admin export for 2024). Highlights:
- Security awareness module (PHI/Sensitive data handling) required within 30 days of hire; 98.6% completion rate for 2024 hires.
- Exceptions: 3 employees had delayed completion >60 days; we documented remedial training completion and manager escalations in the LMS notes field.
- Ongoing remediation: quarterly ‘phish’ simulation and mandatory follow-ups; I included a CSV extract of failures in the report appendix.

Confluence reference for control descriptions: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/Sec/Security+Awareness+Program

Marcus
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: evidence@secureaudit.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Apr 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: CAIQ / SIG - employee vetting and training artifacts

Hi Tanya,

Thank you — attached are the initial deliverables for your review:
- background_checks_summary.csv (redacted to last 4 of SSN where applicable; vendor refs included)
- training_completion_report.pdf (LMS export with completion dates and remediation notes)
- onboarding_checklist.xlsx (signed manager fields where available)

We’ve flagged legacy hires (pre-2022) where a manual record reconciliation is required and documented those rows in the CSV with a note. Termination / offboarding logs are being pulled and will be sent as a separate file (termination-log-2024.csv) once IT confirms system ticket matches — expect that by EOD Thu.

For sensitive fields we have redacted full SSNs and personal phone numbers; if SecureAudit needs unredacted artifacts under NDA please let us know and we'll coordinate with Legal.

You can download the package from our secure S3 staging link: https://s3.redwoodinference.com/evidence/secureaudit/2025-04/onboarding-pack (expires in 14 days).

Would you like a short sync to walk through the exports? I’m free Fri 2025-04-25 between 10:00-12:00 PDT.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: SecureAudit <evidence@secureaudit.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Apr 2025 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: CAIQ / SIG - employee vetting and training artifacts

Hannah — received, thank you. The exports look good. One follow-up: please provide the termination-log-2024.csv that shows system deprovisioning events and ticket refs (we need to trace 10 sampled terminations). Also can you confirm whether contractor offboarding follows the same ticketing workflow or is handled by vendor managers?

If you can drop termination-log-2024.csv into the same S3 folder we’ll validate the sample by EOD Mon.

Regards,
Tanya Roberts
Senior Assurance Analyst
SecureAudit Inc.
